verdict.rationale: LangGraph docs and GitHub materials claim 'production-ready deployment' with scalable infrastructure and a CLI for building/running an 'Agent Server' locally, suggesting some path to expose an agent as an API. However, evidence lacks detail on a true managed runtime (e.g., specifics of LangGraph Platform/Cloud), and a community practitioner explicitly asks how to deploy LangGraph as a production API beyond local 'langgraph serve', indicating the managed-deployment story is underdocumented or unclear in practice.
